decided_from: data already collected — d2-supply-survey.json; no further discovery round was run, which is what §10.6 requires of a NARROW
subject: pre-freeze cost-floor probe scope

excluded_stratum.reason: D2 produced 0 admissible cases in the frozen five-repository historical-supply frame; no primary+reserve pair can be selected.
excluded_stratum.delta_status: D2 is retained unchanged and is NOT refuted — it ran out of consumers for this probe.

validity_limit: The pre-freeze cost probe makes no claim about the cost of semantic-control-flow-dependence cases. Control-flow dependence is excluded from THIS probe only, not from AMA. Later taxonomy discovery may find dense control-flow cells; they may not retroactively become a fourth early case.

rejected_alternative.option: author a new control-flow delta (D3) selected for high occurrence density
rejected_alternative.why_rejected: It would be chosen after observing supply and specifically on a criterion the failed search generated. Even authored blind from provider artifacts, that is a new discovery round aimed at preserving a four-row table — EXTEND AMA-0.5 in a respectable shirt. §10.6 permits NARROW only from data already held.
ascertainment_bias_shape: a high-density criterion was derived from that failure
a delta guaranteed to satisfy the criterion was selected

numeric_consequences.budget_rationale: Three primaries at three hours cannot physically spend more than nine. The freed three hours do not become a longer adjudication or a new permitted search — they are simply unspent. The package cap stays 48 hours and is counted as actually consumed.

withdrawn.what: the `B_floor ≤ 174h` figure recorded on a 0-censored outcome
withdrawn.why: it was derived from four cases under a soft two-cell hypothesis, not a universal constant. After narrowing it no longer follows. The early probe now publishes no monetary projection at all; economics remain a post-freeze question decided on p90 over an untruncated distribution (§8.4).

occurrence_density_disposition.status: hypothesis recorded in d2-supply-survey.json; NOT usable for selecting a delta for this probe

decomposition_to_measure_separately.eligible_repository_density: share of repositories where the fact is applicable at all
decomposition_to_measure_separately.cluster_supply: count of independent repository × delta × cell clusters
decomposition_to_measure_separately.adjudication_yield: accepted clusters per hour of selection and labelling

occurrence_density_disposition.observed_so_far: D1 appears high on the first three. D2 failed at eligible occurrence density — the fact is rare by construction, because accepting the SDK default is the common case. This is a result of the preparatory work, not an obstacle to it.
